explication: This repository reverse-engineers SynthID image watermarks and provides detection, spectral codebook construction, and watermark-removal workflows. The main V4 loop builds a multi-model, multi-color codebook, generates cleaned variants, sends them for manual Gemini-app checking, and uses that feedback to recalibrate the codebook. A separate desktop GUI supports local image cleaning. The graph includes documented analysis and legacy extraction capabilities; unsampled implementation details are represented only where the README or SOURCE INDEX supports them.
